# Delos Recruitment

> Delos Recruitment Ltd is a specialist Rec2Rec (recruitment to recruitment) consultancy based in Surrey, England. We recruit for every role that makes a recruitment business work: trainees, recruiters, sales, marketing, operations and administration. We work across the UK, including London, the Home Counties and Manchester.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Delos Recruitment Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 16163283
- Founded: April 2025 by Maria Gripari, Founder and Director
- Based in: Surrey, England
- Coverage: the whole UK, including London, the Home Counties (Surrey, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire, Kent, Essex, Sussex), Hampshire and Manchester
- Specialism: Rec2Rec, hiring for recruitment businesses
- Roles we recruit for: trainee recruitment consultants, recruiters, sales, marketing, operations and administration
- Clients: recruitment businesses, from startups to SMEs
- Candidates: experienced recruiters looking for their next move, and people new to recruitment (trainee roles need no recruitment experience)
- Candidates are never charged
- Every conversation is confidential
- Contact: hello@delosrecruitment.co.uk, 07537 142 925 (also on WhatsApp), or book a call at https://calendar.app.google/uaRx23B52yra5b9Z9

## Questions recruitment businesses ask us

- Which roles do you recruit for? Every role across your business, from trainees and recruiters right up to director level, plus the sales, marketing, operations and administration teams that keep it running. Every one of those hires shapes how your business grows.
- Why not just work the vacancy ourselves? Your consultants' time is best spent on your clients. Recruiting for your own team takes them off their desks, and the best recruiters are usually busy billing for someone else. They'll often talk to a Rec2Rec when they wouldn't answer a call from a competitor.
- Where do you start? With a proper conversation about your business before we look at the role: how your desks are set up, what your top performers have in common, and what your hiring process looks like, including what's working and what isn't. That shapes who we look for.
- How do you prepare candidates? We complete a full interview preparation session with every candidate, so they put their best foot forward. We talk them through your business, the role and the people they'll meet, so they arrive ready to show you what they can do.
- Can you help us keep the people we hire? Beyond recruiting, we can guide you on becoming an employer of choice, with insights into the market, your competitors and retention.

## Questions candidates ask us

- What is Rec2Rec? Rec2Rec means recruitment to recruitment. It's the only industry we recruit for, so we know the businesses, the roles and what working in recruitment is all about. Whether you're starting out or already an experienced recruiter, we'll take the time to understand what you want and help you find the right next step.

## Common myths about recruitment, and the truth

- Myth: a recruiter just fills the vacancy. Truth: before we search, we learn how your business runs and where you want to take it, so every hire supports your long-term vision as well as the role in front of you.
- Myth: your CV is the most important part of a job search. Truth: A CV gets you noticed, but it can't show who you are. That's why we start with a conversation, to get to know you and understand what you're really looking for.
- Myth: you have to be job hunting to talk to a recruiter. Truth: some of the best moves start with a conversation before you're even looking. Talking to us doesn't commit you to anything.
- Myth: you need experience to become a recruiter. Truth: many great recruiters started with none. What matters is drive, resilience and how you get on with people. The rest can be learned, and a trainee role is where you start.
- Myth: recruitment is just a stop gap. Truth: it can be a career for life. We're honest about what the job really involves before you say yes, so you start somewhere you can grow.
